profile_target: raw integer ATAC counts summed within donor by frozen broad lineage
profile_scale: each training donor-lineage pseudobulk is depth-normalized before equal-donor averaging
mean_track: one equal-donor mean composition across all observed training donor-lineage strata
assay_native_pseudobulk: one equal-donor mean composition for each of five frozen lineages
nearest_context: same-lineage training donor selected by squared Euclidean distance on training-z-scored log1p CPM over training-selected HVGs; profile is that donor-lineage ATAC composition
smoke_peak_universe: 2000 peaks selected by SHA-256 ranking of stable peak identifiers only; ATAC values and outcomes are not used
held_atac_firewall: prepare exports training RNA and ATAC plus query RNA; fit and predict requests withhold the original paired HDF5 and no query ATAC artifact is produced
